en.topic_title: Press group says 5 journalists dismissed at BBC Hong Kong amid bullying claims, urges review
en.topic_summary:
The International Federation of Journalists (IFJ) has urged the BBC to investigate reports of bullying at its Hong Kong bureau after five long-serving journalists were dismissed.



The BBC headquarters in London. File Photo: Tom Grundy/HKFP.
